title.zh: 贝塞尔伽马 L 极点系数

summary: Return fixed rational residue and pole tables indexed by Bessel order |n|+1.

identity.relation: maximum harmonic N to residue and pole tables for orders 0..N
identity.direction: maximum harmonic N to residue and pole tables for orders 0..N
identity.definition: The fixed L-pole residues and positions approximate Bessel-Gamma terms by rational pole sums; table key is |n|+1.
identity.model: rational approximation of Maxwellian finite-Larmor-radius terms
identity.coordinates: integer harmonic and complex pole axes
identity.boundary: frozen tables cover |n|=0..7; requests beyond them fail
assumptions: Input units and normalization follow the declared ports; no physical parameters are inferred.

inputs.name: max_harmonic
inputs.description: 调用者将要组装的贝塞尔最大阶数 $N$
inputs.constraints: 非负整数，且 `max_harmonic+1` 不超过冻结表的最大系数序号 8。

outputs.name: orders
outputs.description: 返回的系数序号列表，即 $|n|+1$ 从 1 到 `max_harmonic+1`

outputs.name: order_lengths
outputs.description: 每个系数序号的极点个数 $L(|n|+1)$

outputs.name: residues
outputs.shape: 以序号为键，值为长度 `order_lengths[序号]` 的复数组

outputs.name: poles
outputs.shape: 以序号为键，值为长度 `order_lengths[序号]` 的复数组
outputs.constraints: 有限复数，极点成对共轭出现。

outputs.name: total_poles
outputs.description: 返回的全部极点总数 $\sum_{|n|\le N}L(|n|+1)$
outputs.constraints: 等于色散矩阵每组分速度块的维数。

preconditions: frozen tables cover |n|=0..7; requests beyond them fail
supported: Return fixed rational residue and pole tables indexed by Bessel order |n|+1.
excluded: No mode identity or arbitrary-parameter accuracy is inferred beyond the declared numerical method.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for declared invalid inputs; numeric conversion errors may propagate for unsupported Python objects.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Numerical backend errors propagate; no fallback relation is substituted.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; no iterative root solve is exposed.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial mapping is returned after an exception.

provenance.lineage_summary: SciRel D2 retained this distinct fluidBW r43 numerical relation after comparison with maintained kinetic entries; the source-scope freeze and finite oracles are development evidence, not expert approval.

example.code:
from scirel.kinetic import get_gamma_lpole_coefficients
r=get_gamma_lpole_coefficients(max_harmonic=0); assert r['order_lengths'][1]==12
